message.reasoning_content: "Dizzy Miss Lizzy" appears on both Help! (UK) and Beatles for Sale (US). First released: Beatles for Sale (US, Dec 1964), UK Help! Aug 1965. The "first released" album — Beatles for Sale US Beatles VI actually... Dizzy Miss Lizzy on Beatles VI (US, June 1965), before Help! UK.
